season_share_reference.rule: games: n / season_games_reference; attempts and minutes: n / (season_games_reference x median per-game units of rotation player-seasons, those that played in at least half of the most games any player played that season); RAPM: season-scale possessions per side / (season_games_reference x possessions per team-game of the latest season fit)
